prompt:
High-fidelity desktop website first-viewport comp, 16:9, for World Champion Taekwondo Washougal. Concept title: “Dojang Portal.” This is a real trust-first family martial arts website, not a WebGL demo, game, dashboard, movie poster, or MMA gym ad. The entire viewport is one full-bleed, cinematic documentary photograph inside a real taekwondo dojang: three children, diverse and around elementary-school age, in clean white doboks, holding focused taekwondo stances as one coordinated row on interlocking red and blue mats. The children and mats fill the screen; the camera is at a natural waist-height, slightly wide editorial angle, with authentic fluorescent-window mixed light, subtle motion and sweat, believable fabric folds, real hands and feet, candid concentration, and a deep navy-black shadow field around the room. Keep faces dignified, natural, and non-commercial. Fine analog film grain across the image, restrained contrast, deep inky navy color grade; the sacred blue is present in the mats and shadows, and sacred red appears only in the action treatment and naturally in the red mat. No neon, no glowing effects, no dollar amount, no $40, no belts used as decorative UI, no cards, no gradients, no glass panels, no fake statistics.

The interface must be unmistakably a sophisticated website while almost disappearing into the photograph. Place a tiny understated school mark and the small text “WCT WASHOUGAL” at the extreme upper-left edge in thin warm-white sans-serif. At the extreme upper-right edge, place a real horizontal navigation in tiny crisp type: “Programs   Schedule   Instructors   Contact”. Use generous negative space and no conventional header bar. Across the lower-left / middle clearing, set one huge, quiet, elegant extended grotesk wordmark over the image, exactly: “World Champion Taekwondo Washougal”. It should be warm white, thin-to-regular weight, tightly art-directed, approximately two lines at most, calm rather than loud, readable but integrated with the photograph. At the lower-right margin, place the only action: “Reserve your first class” in small precise type with a thin sacred-red underline or narrow red rule and a subtle right arrow; no filled button. Include one tiny location line near the bottom-left edge: “WASHOUGAL, WASHINGTON”. The composition should feel like an award-winning cultural institution site or high-end documentary portal: full-bleed living photography, edge-aligned navigation, refined typography, exact spacing, calm authority, warmth, local family trust. Preserve legibility with only subtle natural shadow falloff behind type, not visible boxes or overlays. Pixel-polished 1440×810 desktop landing-page comp.
